chapterInfo.content:
16
Afahyɛ ahodoɔ no ho mmara
1 # Eks 23.14-17; 34.18-24; Lew 23 Hwɛ bosome Abib na di Twam ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ bosome Abib mu na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yii wo firii Misraim anadwo. 2Enti kum Twam afɔdeɛ no ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, nnwan ne anantwie, faako a AWURADE ayi sɛ ne din ntena no. 3Nni mmɔreka paanoo nka ho; nnanson na di apiti, amanehunu paanoo, ɛfiri sɛ ɛherɛ so na wofirii Misraim asase soɔ, na woakae wo Misraim asase so fire da no, wo nkwa nna nyinaa. 4Na mma wɔnnhunu mmɔreka wɔ wo nkyɛn, w’asase nyinaa so nnanson; nso mma nam a wɔku no da a ɛdi kan anwummerɛ no bi nnka nnkɔsi anɔpa. 5Nkum Twam no wɔ wo nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no biara mu, 6gye faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi sɛ ne din ntena no, ɛhɔ na kum Twam no anwummerɛ a owia rekɔtɔ no, wo Misraim fire berɛ no mu; 7na ma no mmen na di no faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ hɔ, na adeɛ kye a, woasane akɔ wo ntomadan mu. 8Nnansia na di apiti, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no nyɛ afahyɛ nhyiam mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; nyɛ adwuma biara.
9Adapɛn nson na kan fa; da a wɔrefiri aseɛ de kantankrankyi ahyɛ ayuo mu no na firi kan adapɛn nson; 10na di adapɛn dapɔnna ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ wo nsam ayamyi afɔdeɛ sɛdeɛ wahyira woɔ no. 11#Deut 16.16; Eks 20.24 Na ma w’ani nnye AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, wo ne wo babarima ne wo babaa ne w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne awisiaa ne okunafoɔ a wɔwɔ mo mu, faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi sɛ ne din ntena no; 12#Deut 5.15 na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim, na hwɛ na yɛ ahyɛdeɛ yi.
13Di asese nnapɔnna nnanson, berɛ a woaboaboa w’ayuporebea ne wo nsa-kyi-amena mu adeɛ ano no; 14#Deut 16.11; 26.11 na ma w’ani nnye wo nnapɔnna no mu, wo ne wo babarima, wo babaa, w’akoa, w’afenaa, Lewini, ɔhɔhoɔ, awisiaa ne okunafoɔ a wɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu. 15Nnanson na di dapɔnna no ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn faako a wayie hɔ: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo, wo nnɔbaeɛ mu ne wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa mu; enti ma w’ani nnye ara.
16Afirinhyia baako mu mprɛnsa na wo mmarima nyinaa mmɛyi wɔn ho adi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim faako a ɔbɛkyerɛ hɔ. Apiti nnapɔnna, adapɛn dapɔnna ne asese nnapɔnna mu; na wɔmmfa nsapan mmmɛyi wɔn ho adi AWURADE anim. 17Obiara mma deɛ ne nsa bɛso soɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nhyira a ɔde ahyira woɔ no teɛ.
Atemmufoɔ ne atemmuo ho asɛm
18 # Deut 20.8-9; Num 11.16 Sisi wo so atemmufoɔ ne mpanimfoɔ, wo nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛdeɛ wo mmusuakuo teɛ no nyinaa mu, na wɔmfa atɛntenenee mmu ɔman no. 19#Deut 1.17 Nnane atemmuo ani, nhwɛ nnipa anim na nnye adanmudeɛ; na adanmudeɛ fira anyansafoɔ ani, na ɛdane teneneefoɔ nsɛm ani butu. 20Asɛntenenee nko ara akyi na die, na woanya nkwa, na woakɔfa asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no.
21 # Deut 7.5 Ntɛ nnua biara mfa nyɛ abosompɔ wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia a worebɛsie no ho; 22#Lew 26.1 na mfa ɔboɔ dum nsi hɔ mfa; na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ ne no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Hwɛ bosome Abib na di Twam ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ bosome Abib mu na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yii wo firii Misraim anadwo. Enti kum Twam afɔdeɛ no ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, nnwan ne anantwie, faako a AWURADE ayi sɛ ne din ntena no. Nni mmɔreka paanoo nka ho; nnanson na di apiti, amanehunu paanoo, ɛfiri sɛ ɛherɛ so na wofirii Misraim asase soɔ, na woakae wo Misraim asase so fire da no, wo nkwa nna nyinaa. Na mma wɔnnhunu mmɔreka wɔ wo nkyɛn, w’asase nyinaa so nnanson; nso mma nam a wɔku no da a ɛdi kan anwummerɛ no bi nnka nnkɔsi anɔpa. Nkum Twam no wɔ wo nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no biara mu, gye faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi sɛ ne din ntena no, ɛhɔ na kum Twam no anwummerɛ a owia rekɔtɔ no, wo Misraim fire berɛ no mu; na ma no mmen na di no faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ hɔ, na adeɛ kye a, woasane akɔ wo ntomadan mu. Nnansia na di apiti, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no nyɛ afahyɛ nhyiam mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; nyɛ adwuma biara.
Adapɛn nson na kan fa; da a wɔrefiri aseɛ de kantankrankyi ahyɛ ayuo mu no na firi kan adapɛn nson; na di adapɛn dapɔnna ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ wo nsam ayamyi afɔdeɛ sɛdeɛ wahyira woɔ no. Na ma w’ani nnye AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, wo ne wo babarima ne wo babaa ne w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne awisiaa ne okunafoɔ a wɔwɔ mo mu, faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi sɛ ne din ntena no; na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim, na hwɛ na yɛ ahyɛdeɛ yi.
Di asese nnapɔnna nnanson, berɛ a woaboaboa w’ayuporebea ne wo nsa-kyi-amena mu adeɛ ano no; na ma w’ani nnye wo nnapɔnna no mu, wo ne wo babarima, wo babaa, w’akoa, w’afenaa, Lewini, ɔhɔhoɔ, awisiaa ne okunafoɔ a wɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu. Nnanson na di dapɔnna no ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn faako a wayie hɔ: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo, wo nnɔbaeɛ mu ne wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa mu; enti ma w’ani nnye ara.
Afirinhyia baako mu mprɛnsa na wo mmarima nyinaa mmɛyi wɔn ho adi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim faako a ɔbɛkyerɛ hɔ. Apiti nnapɔnna, adapɛn dapɔnna ne asese nnapɔnna mu; na wɔmmfa nsapan mmmɛyi wɔn ho adi AWURADE anim. Obiara mma deɛ ne nsa bɛso soɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nhyira a ɔde ahyira woɔ no teɛ.

Sisi wo so atemmufoɔ ne mpanimfoɔ, wo nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛdeɛ wo mmusuakuo teɛ no nyinaa mu, na wɔmfa atɛntenenee mmu ɔman no. Nnane atemmuo ani, nhwɛ nnipa anim na nnye adanmudeɛ; na adanmudeɛ fira anyansafoɔ ani, na ɛdane teneneefoɔ nsɛm ani butu. Asɛntenenee nko ara akyi na die, na woanya nkwa, na woakɔfa asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no.
Ntɛ nnua biara mfa nyɛ abosompɔ wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia a worebɛsie no ho; na mfa ɔboɔ dum nsi hɔ mfa; na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ ne no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
